p: Funstation here is very much a family arcade, built around fun games and prize tickets rather than anything aimed at adults, so it's a safe bet for kids' parties and school-holiday outings. With so many activities under one roof, the biggest danger is trying to do everything at once. Pick two or three, set a budget and a rough time limit, and you'll leave with happy kids rather than tired, overwhelmed ones.

Merry Hill is one of the West Midlands' big shopping destinations, sitting in Brierley Hill with easy access by road and bus. Next door, the Waterfront development sits beside the canal, and a stroll along the towpath is a nice break from the bright lights inside. Weekends and school holidays are busiest, so if you want a calmer visit, a weekday morning is your friend.

The wider Dudley area is stuffed with brilliant days out. The Black Country Living Museum recreates life in the region's industrial past with old streets, shops, a fairground and even an underground mine experience, and it's a firm favourite with families and history fans alike. Dudley Zoo and Castle sits on a hill above the town, with animals living among the ruins of a medieval castle, and the Dudley Canal Trust runs boat trips into the tunnels and caverns beneath the hill. Put any of these together with an afternoon at Merry Hill and you've got a cracking weekend sorted.
